wordProblems.q: Mason has 17 balloons. 5 balloons pop. How many balloons does Mason have left?
Layla has 15 books on her shelf. Her mum buys her 5 more books. How many books does Layla have now?
Max has 17 crayons. He loses 4 crayons at school. How many crayons does Max have left?
Nora picks 3 oranges from a tree. Then Nora picks 9 more oranges. How many oranges did Nora pick in all?
There are 9 ducks in a pond. 6 ducks swim away. How many ducks are left in the pond?
Grace makes 17 cupcakes. Her friend brings 3 more cupcakes. How many cupcakes are there in all?
Henry has 14 toy cars. He gives 2 toy cars to his little brother. How many toy cars does Henry have left?
Amelia finds 14 seashells on the beach in the morning and 3 seashells in the afternoon. How many seashells did Amelia find in all?
Ruby has 17 flowers in her garden. She picks 9 flowers for her teacher. How many flowers are left in the garden?
James eats 3 grapes at lunch and 10 grapes after school. How many grapes did James eat in all?
Mia is reading a book with 14 pages. Mia reads 10 pages today. How many pages are left to read?
A baker makes 13 muffins in the morning and 7 muffins in the afternoon. How many muffins did the baker make in all?
There are 14 fish in a tank. The shop sells 1 fish. How many fish are left in the tank?
Isabella has 7 red beads and 13 blue beads. How many beads does Isabella have in all?
Sam collects 18 toy trains. He lends 16 trains to a friend. How many trains does Sam have left?
Ruby has 11 apples in a basket. Ruby eats 9 apples. How many apples are left in the basket?
Owen draws 17 stars on Monday and 2 stars on Tuesday. How many stars did Owen draw in all?
A monkey has 10 bananas. It eats 6 bananas. How many bananas does the monkey have left?
Nora has 6 apples. Nora buys 5 more apples. How many apples does Nora have now?
Leo has 5 stickers. Leo gives 4 stickers to Sam. How many stickers does Leo have left?
Ruby buys 16 peaches at the market. Then Ruby buys 2 more peaches. How many peaches did Ruby buy in all?
There are 15 frogs sitting on a log. 10 frogs jump into the water. How many frogs are left on the log?
Sara collects 10 smooth rocks at the river and 9 smooth rocks at the lake. How many smooth rocks did Sara collect in all?
Amelia has 16 cherries in a bowl. She gives 5 cherries to her friend. How many cherries are left in the bowl?
2 red buses and 13 yellow buses are parked at the station. How many buses are parked at the station in all?
Zoe has 17 pairs of socks in a drawer. Zoe takes 2 pairs out to wear this week. How many pairs of socks are left in the drawer?
Leo flies 4 kites in the park. His dad brings 12 more kites. How many kites are there now?
Sara has 11 candies in a jar. She shares 9 candies with her sister. How many candies are left in the jar?
Noah picks 13 lemons from a tree in the morning and 3 lemons in the evening. How many lemons did Noah pick in all?
There are 16 rabbits in a garden. 4 rabbits hop away. How many rabbits are left in the garden?
